table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	Item.Name,  
	aliasname=item.customicode, 
	active=CASE item.active WHEN 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,
	Item.purprice,   
	Item.PackUnits,   
	PackingDesc=Item.PackingDesc,
	QTY = isnull(sum(GodownDetail.CurrQty),0),   
	GenericItem = GenericItem.Name,
	Manufacturer.name,
	classname=itemclass.name,
	Category=itemcategory.name,
	Packing = (SELECT IP.Name FROM ItemPacking IP WHERE IP.PackCode = Item.Packcode),
	Retailprice = Round(Item.RetailPrice / CASE WHEN Item.PackUnits > 0 THEN Item.PackUnits ELSE 1 END, 2),
	SalePrice5 = Round(Item.Saleprice5 / CASE WHEN Item.PackUnits > 0 THEN Item.PackUnits ELSE 1 END, 2),
	UnitPrice = Case :ai_pricetype 
						WHEN 2 THEN Round(Item.purprice / CASE WHEN Item.PackUnits > 0 THEN Item.PackUnits ELSE 1 END, 2)
						WHEN 1 THEN Round(max(Item.Saleprice) / CASE WHEN Item.PackUnits > 0 THEN Item.PackUnits ELSE 1 END, 2)
						WHEN 3 THEN Round(max(Item.avgprice), 2)
					END ,
	PackQty =isnull( Round(sum(GodownDetail.CurrQty) / CASE WHEN Item.PackUnits > 0 THEN Item.PackUnits ELSE 1 END, 2),0),
	StockValue = isnull(Sum(GodownDetail.CurrQty),0) *
					 Case :ai_pricetype 
						 WHEN 2 THEN Round(Item.purprice / CASE WHEN Item.PackUnits > 0 THEN Item.PackUnits ELSE 1 END, 2)
						 WHEN 1 THEN Round(max(Item.Saleprice) / CASE WHEN Item.PackUnits > 0 THEN Item.PackUnits ELSE 1 END, 2)
						 WHEN 3 THEN Round(max(Item.avgprice), 2)
					END
FROM 
	GenericItem,
	Manufacturer,   
	Item
	LEFT OUTER JOIN GodownDetail ON (Item.ICode = GodownDetail.ICode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN ItemClass ON (Item.iccode=itemclass.iccode),
	ItemCategory
WHERE 
	( Item.GenericCode IN (:genericcode) ) AND
	( Item.GenericCode = GenericItem.GenericCode ) and
	( Item.ManfCode = Manufacturer.manfcode ) and
	( Item.icatcode=itemcategory.icatcode) and
	( Item.active=1)
GROUP BY 
	Item.name,
	item.customicode, 
	Item.Active,
	Item.purprice, 
	Item.PackUnits, 
	Item.PackingDesc,
	GenericItem.name,
	Manufacturer.name,
	itemcategory.name,
	Itemclass.name ,
	Item.PackCode,
	Item.RetailPrice,
	Item.Saleprice5
